//: Production counterpart of the dev-server proxy in vite.config.ts.
The API client calls a RELATIVE '/api' (src/lib/api.ts) on purpose:
the browser then treats the session cookie as first-party, so the
API's httpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookies are sent on every request
and the CSRF guard's Origin check passes without weakening either.
The Render host therefore never appears in frontend source.
In development Vite proxies /api and /media to the API. In
production this file does the same job. Without it, /api/* resolves
to the static site itself and every call 404s with
x-vercel-error: NOT_FOUND, which is what broke sign-in.
THIS FILE ONLY TAKES EFFECT IF THE VERCEL PROJECT'S ROOT DIRECTORY
IS apps/admin. At any other root Vercel never reads it and the
symptoms above return unchanged.
The destination is literal: Vercel does not interpolate environment
variables into rewrite destinations. If the API moves, change it
here and redeploy.
Ordering: Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so
real files under /assets are served directly and never reach these
rules. /api and /media are matched first, and the SPA fallback is
additionally written as a negative lookahead so an API path cannot
be rewritten to index.html even if it were evaluated out of order.
That fallback must stay last so a refresh on a client-side route
still returns index.html.
